meta.description: Registry for bounded perturbation-scale sensitivity and recursive pruning-threshold fragmentation behavior in Phase 3.

pruning_scale_entries.name: Branch Pruning Scale Sensitivity
pruning_scale_entries.purpose: Represent bounded perturbation-scale sensitivity and recursive pruning-threshold fragmentation behavior across continuation systems.

pruning_scale_conditions.name: perturbation_scale_sensitivity_remains_defined
pruning_scale_conditions.description: Formal support for evaluating how variations in input scale impact branch pruning effectiveness.

pruning_scale_conditions.name: recursive_pruning_updates_remain_admissible
pruning_scale_conditions.description: Updates to pruning thresholds under recursion must satisfy current process admissibility windows.

pruning_scale_conditions.name: branch_explosion_detection_limits_remain_classifiable
pruning_scale_conditions.description: Runaway branch growth detection must map to registered transition or stability classes.

pruning_scale_conditions.name: window_dynamics_do_not_force_global_pruning_stability
pruning_scale_conditions.description: Dynamic window shifts do not imply a globally stable or invariant pruning threshold.

pruning_scale_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_pruning_thresholds_remain_bounded
pruning_scale_conditions.description: The influence of frame orientation on pruning thresholds must stay within stable limits.

pruning_scale_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_scale_witness
pruning_scale_conditions.description: Pruning at different scales must not eliminate all admissible continuation candidates.

pruning_scale_conditions.name: recursive_threshold_fragmentation_remains_detectable
pruning_scale_conditions.description: Breakdown of global pruning rules into local, fragmented thresholds must be formally trackable.

pruning_scale_conditions.name: pruning_scale_instability_remains_detectable
pruning_scale_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of pruning scale stability.
